snippet.title: Fruit vs Juice: Same Sugar, Different Result
snippet.description:
Is the sugar in an apple the same as the sugar in apple juice? Fruit vs Juice: Same Sugar, Different Result: the facts in under a minute, animated in 3D.

Watch the full video: "What Sugar Does to Your Body (3D Animation)" on our channel.
